resources.string: AI is not set up or the API key is not valid. Check it in Settings.
You have reached your AI provider\'s usage limit. Try again in a while.
Can\'t reach the AI provider. Check your network.

Can\'t open a secure connection to the AI provider: the certificate is not valid or that address doesn\'t use HTTPS. Check the URL or the server.
The AI URL starts with http:// and Mysone only connects over https://. Change it in Settings › AI.
